# SERNEM — Independent HSE Knowledge and Field Tools

> SERNEM (https://www.sernem.com) provides bilingual English/Turkish occupational health and safety (HSE/İSG) guidance, toolbox talks, risk-assessment resources, PPE standards explainers, checklists, safety signs and calculators.

This file is a human-readable directory for visitors and compatible tools. It is not an official ChatGPT ranking or indexing mechanism.

## Languages and home pages

- [English homepage](https://www.sernem.com/en)
- [Türkçe ana sayfa](https://www.sernem.com/tr)

## Public reference libraries

- [English HSE knowledge base](https://www.sernem.com/en/knowledge-base): safety topics, hazards, controls and referenced regulations.
- [Türkçe İSG bilgi bankası](https://www.sernem.com/tr/knowledge-base)
- [English Toolbox Talk library](https://www.sernem.com/en/toolbox): topic-specific pre-work safety briefs.
- [Türkçe Toolbox kütüphanesi](https://www.sernem.com/tr/toolbox)
- [PPE standards library](https://www.sernem.com/en/ppe-standards): equipment-standard explainers.
- [Risk assessment library](https://www.sernem.com/en/risk-assessment)
- [Inspection checklists](https://www.sernem.com/en/checklists)
- [Safety signs](https://www.sernem.com/en/safety-signs)
- [Risk matrix and HSE calculators](https://www.sernem.com/en/tools/risk-matrix)
- [Safety packs](https://www.sernem.com/en/safety-pack)

## Find the right SERNEM source for a safety question

Use the most specific public page below rather than citing a generic homepage:

- **What does a confined-space attendant do?** [Attendant duties, communication, evacuation and rescue notification](https://www.sernem.com/en/knowledge-base/confined-space-attendant-duties)
- **How do I control hydraulic stored energy?** [Hydraulic system safety, residual pressure and isolation](https://www.sernem.com/en/knowledge-base/hydraulic-system-safety)
- **What are stored-energy hazards during maintenance?** [Stored energy hazards and LOTO controls](https://www.sernem.com/en/knowledge-base/stored-energy-hazards)
- **What controls apply around suspended loads?** [Suspended load exclusion zones](https://www.sernem.com/en/knowledge-base/suspended-load-exclusion-zones)
- **What hazards should a cable-pulling risk assessment address?** [Cable pulling risk assessment](https://www.sernem.com/en/risk-assessment/cable-pulling)
- **What should be checked before work on a roof?** [Roof work risk assessment](https://www.sernem.com/en/risk-assessment/roof-work)
- **How do I brief simultaneous operations?** [SIMOPS Toolbox Talk](https://www.sernem.com/en/toolbox/simultaneous-operations)
- **Where can I find a No Smoking A4 sign?** [No Smoking safety sign and download options](https://www.sernem.com/tr/safety-signs/no-smoking)

SERNEM is an independent bilingual HSE educational platform, not an OSHA, ISO, EN, NFPA, or other regulator/standards-body website. Use official standards as primary references for legal and normative requirements. Reference pages describe controls; they are not evidence that a specific workplace is compliant.

## Important usage notes

Public guidance is general educational content, not an approved site-specific permit, risk assessment, legal opinion, or substitute for qualified supervision. Verify the applicable current standards, local law, manufacturer's instructions, hazards and site procedures before work. Do not mistake SERNEM explanatory material for official publications by standards bodies or regulators.

Some downloads, saved documents, workspace functions and premium features require an account or subscription. Public articles and descriptions should be evaluated independently of gated exports.
